Name: Crimson Butterfly
Information:
**Crimson Butterflies**

The Crimson Butterflies were a clan of swordswomen from the cursed land of Honokuni who were dragged into a war against the nobles of the land, and sacrificed during the war’s final days during a suicidal conflict. They turned against the wishes of their leader Hatsume Tsubone to aid the tyrant Hirohito-no-Minamoto, and the land they fought to make better would become cursed by dark powers. After it was cursed and dragged into the Realm of Shadow, the clan was revived as bound spirits under Hirohito’s service, and remained that way for untold ages.

Eventually, Honokuni would be freed from its curse, and the souls of the Crimson Butterflies were saved. However, many escaped back into the Material Plane, and remained vengeful, dark spirits who wander the world seeking revenge against those who have any ties to Honokuni. They appear often when conflicts between similar factions to their own arise, and haunt old graveyards and battlefields. Those who are freed from this fate return to their ancient training grounds as a spirit, and remain there with their own.

**Twisted Purposes**

While under Hirohito’s control, the Butterflies were assigned to the chief generals who maintained his control over Honokuni - known as the Table of Senrai. Their spirits were twisted to better serve these individuals. The different stat blocks here represent several of the final versions of the Crimson Butterflies, which still wander the earth.

***Ashstorm Butterflies.*** Assigned to an efreeti enforcer who ruled Honokuni’s skies from a floating ship of gold and bronze, the Ashstorm Butterflies are able to deal with exhaustion and blistering heat, and fight with dangerous hand-to-hand martial combat techniques. They are immune to fire damage, and all of their attacks deal an additional damage die of fire damage (and their necrotic damage becomes fire).

***Bastille Butterflies.*** The Bastille Butterflies were co-opted to serve as dancers and performers for a vain lich who was obsessed with beauty and self-idolization. They are more mobile. They have the Evasion quality trait, they have proficiency and expertise in Stealth checks, and their base movement speed is 10 feet more.

***Paleblood Butterflies.*** The Paleblood Butterflies served until a solemn, conflicted hunter appeared who attempted to lessen the pain of the people through acts of quiet, necessary evil. They use the hunter’s divine rites, and so their necrotic damage is radiant instead, and they deal an additional two damage die of radiant damage with their weapon attacks. These spirits have the strongest sense of honor, and will rarely attack anything that is not a beast, fiend, planetouched, or monstrosity.

**Various Spirit Types**

The Crimson Butterfly may appear with the creature type “spirit (fey)” when they are pure, freed from Honokuni’s curse, and have rejoined the spirits of their comrades with Hatsume Tsubone. Conversely, they will appear as “spirit (undead)” when they are still enraged and violent, and corrupted by their time in Honokuni. The destruction of the undead variant may free the Crimson Butterfly’s spirit, but only that is done with sympathy and understanding for the poor soul’s plight.

Stat Blocks.title: Crimson Butterfly
languages: understands Common and Elvish, but doesn’t speak

traits.name: Discorporation
traits.description: If the spirit is killed, its body vanishes in a ghostly fashion. It then reappears in 1d10 hours in the same place (or within 30 feet) with full health. If killed by a creature, it can sense that creature’s location for 1 week if they are within one mile of it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The spirit uses its Frightful Gaze, then makes two attacks.

actions.name: Blood-Draining Sword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Spirit Longbow
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d10 + 4) piercing damage plus 5 (1d10) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Fearful Gaze
actions.description: The spirit attempts to inflict terror in the heart of one creature who can see it within 60 feet. Its target must make a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw, and on a failure is frightened of all other Crimson Butterflies for 1 minute, during which time they reattempt the saving throw at the end of each of their turns, ending the effect on a success. A creature who succeeds either save is immune to this effect from Crimson Butterflies with the same CR or lower for 24 hours.

bonus_actions.name: Invisibility
bonus_actions.description: The spirit turns invisible until they take an action that targets another creature, or the spirit takes damage. Once they lose invisibility they cannot use this action again for 1 minute.
